name: Tell coordinator
responsibility: The tell_coordinator tool of the coordinator namespace a workhorse is started with, named by the host: tell the coordinator one thing while it works
description: Its manifest is the reviewed template filled with the host's namespace and product name, pinned by the digest of those bytes. While voice is live, a call becomes workhorse news for the coordinator of the workhorse's tab session. With no voice session nothing is sent, and the workhorse is told nobody is listening.
